title: Very Cute!
text: Very Cute!. I love decorating for Halloween. I saw this and had to have it! While it is cute, I was very disappointed in the quality. One of the witch's shoes is split open and exposes a lot of white fluff. I have included a picture of that. I'm going to have to stitch it closed. The legs are movable so I may be able to position it so it's not noticeable, but I really should have to do that. There's also several spots where there are large clumps of dried glue. The glue is clear, but it's very noticeable, too. I do like it, but I wish it didn't require the fixing.
